# M11 offline compiler inputs

**English** | [简体中文](../../zh-CN/third-party/m11.md)

The development image contains source-built GCC 11.2.0 (C/C++ only), GNU
binutils 2.37 and GNU make 4.4.1. `ports/gcc/build.py`, invoked by `build.sh`,
defines all build flags; `inputs.json` records every upstream URL and SHA-256.
The checksum-locked musl.cc GCC 11.2.1 native archive is used only as the host
bootstrap compiler. Guest application CRT, libc, C/C++ headers, libgcc and
libstdc++ are rebuilt from musl 1.2.4 and GCC 11.2.0 sources. Static build-tool
binaries also contain host runtime code from the bootstrap.
GMP 6.2.1, MPFR 4.1.0 and MPC 1.2.1 are statically linked build dependencies.

GCC and make retain GPLv3-or-later; binutils retains its upstream GPL/LGPL
boundaries. GCC runtime files retain the GCC Runtime Library Exception.
musl retains its MIT license. GMP uses LGPLv3-or-later/GPLv2-or-later; MPFR
uses LGPLv3-or-later; MPC uses LGPLv3-or-later. No third-party code is relicensed
as Apache-2.0 or linked into the kernel.

Source archives, generated configuration, original license files and local
recipes must accompany any binary toolchain redistribution. The musl.cc archive
is a bootstrap input; its full corresponding sources and configuration must be
provided before redistributing its runtime binaries. Local development images
are for validation; they are not a source-complete public toolchain release.

Primary references: <https://gcc.gnu.org/install/>,
<https://sourceware.org/binutils/>, <https://www.gnu.org/software/make/>,
<https://musl.cc/>, <https://musl.libc.org/>.
